question: Should ordinary `birdclaw init` automatically query the default authenticated xurl OAuth2 account, or should live identity adoption require an explicit option or hydration command?
rationale: Current main separates local initialization from live profile hydration, while the PR intentionally combines them and adds persistent account-selection behavior; repository product policy does not conclusively authorize that default change.

options.title: Require explicit adoption
options.body: Keep default initialization local-only and run authenticated identity adoption only with `--account` or another explicit live-selection option.

options.title: Adopt default automatically
options.body: Allow ordinary initialization to query xurl and adopt its default OAuth2 account after compatibility and live-behavior proof covers every fallback path.

recommendation.title: Require explicit adoption
recommendation.body: Keep default initialization local-only and run authenticated identity adoption only with `--account` or another explicit live-selection option.

likelyOwner.reason: The choice changes the repository's local-first initialization contract and account-selection UX, making the repository owner the strongest available decision route.
